text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing the popular movie and 
stepping out of the theater, I spotted 
Ryoka Tsurugi. She appeared to be intently 
observing the audience.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
—The age demographic ranges from teens to 
thirties, with roughly an even split 
between male and female, I'd say...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Man, I had no idea that actor could pull 
off such an intense performance! Totally 
blew me away!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I know, right?! He had that handsome 
heartthrob image, but that villainous face 
gave me total chills! Villains are awesome 
too!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
The casting and its sheer 
unexpectedness... Word of mouth is bound 
to boost audience turnout. If only we 
could achieve that same effect with 
videos――
choice_data_list: ...Ms. Tsurugi. Are you on the clock?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Trainer. Yes, just a bit of market 
research.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Did you just finish watching a movie, 
Trainer? How was it?
choice_data_list:
The action was so flashy, I really enjoyed 
it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As we passionately discussed our 
impressions of the movie, voices from 
other audience members could be heard here 
and there as well.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
That final showdown in the snowy mountains 
was seriously on the edge of my seat.

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
Totally, totally. The moment they plunged 
off that cliff, my heart clenched up right 
along with them.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
No, listening to the audience's reactions— 
it just made me feel happy as well.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
It's strange, isn't it? Even though it's 
not a piece I had anything to do with.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
And yet, entertainment like this brings a 
smile to everyone's faces. And makes me 
smile too――

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Seeing happiness spread outward like 
that... made me realize once again just 
how wonderful it is.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
That's why encountering such wonderful 
works always fills me with motivation!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing her wholehearted wish for others' 
happiness warmed me to the very core.
